title: Mobile Preparation Checklist
description: Configure Android packaging settings and produce an APK (if Android SDK available).
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Set up your project for Android deployment.

1. In **Project Settings → Platforms → Android**, configure:
   - **Package Name** (com.yourcompany.yourgame)
   - **Store Version** (1)
   - **Minimum SDK** 26, **Target SDK** 33
2. Click **Configure Now** to install Android SDK/NDK (requires internet).
3. In **Packaging** settings, add your level to the map list.
4. Under **Android → Build**, ensure **Support arm64** is checked (modern requirement).
5. Connect an Android device via USB with USB Debugging enabled.
6. Package: **File → Package Project → Android → ASTC** (or ETC2).
7. If an APK is produced, install it via `adb install MyGame.apk` or copy to device.
8. Test performance on device: note any UI scaling issues or performance drops.

**Note:** If you don't have an Android device or SDK installed, simply go through the settings and document the changes you would make.

**Expect:** A functional APK (if building) or a properly configured Android project ready for building.
hints: If packaging fails, check the Android SDK path in Project Settings.
Reduce texture sizes (set Maximum Texture Size in Texture Editor) for mobile to save memory.
expectedOutput: Android package configuration complete, APK generated (or project ready for device testing).
